_about: Compiler/linker hardening flags, as policy. `cargo xtask verify-hardening-flags` fails closed unless every `common` flag appears (outside comments) in every registered build path, and every path's `extra` flags appear in that path. RUSTFLAGS does not merge with .cargo/config.toml and the tool builds never read the app's config, so the two declaration sites are checked against this one list. Adding a build path means adding it here; an unregistered site fails rather than being ignored.

common.why: resolve static imports from System32 only; matters more for tools, which run from writable CI directories
backward-edge CFI: opts into the hardware shadow stack, the ROP defense CFG does not provide

extra.why: self-contained CRT by choice; accepts not inheriting CRT patches (tools get them from the runner image instead)
stack canaries; requires build-std, which the app uses and the tools do not
a std built without the mitigations is a build failure, not a silent downgrade
reproducible link (deterministic PE timestamp/GUID), stamped afterwards to the commit epoch

paths.what: the five PE build tools (per-tool RUSTFLAGS from tools/rustflags/<name> are appended by the producer and cross-checked there)
